component_conventions.availability: Every cohort row is a player who has a stat row in the game; availability (did he play) is therefore not measurable from these receipts and is never inferred.
component_conventions.in_sample_note: Targets, carries and rushing yards cohorts come from receipts of 2024 W1-18 / W9-18, the seasons used to select the frozen Phase1D/Phase1B configs: DESCRIPTIVE and optimistic for the frozen chain. Receiving yards and receptions come from 2025 validation receipts.

multiplicative_chains.incumbent_receiving: T x Phase1F yards per target E
multiplicative_chains.receiving_yards: targets T x catch rate C x (completed air per catch A + YAC per catch Y); identity verified in Phase1H (ypt = C x (A + Y))
multiplicative_chains.rushing_yards: TEAM_VOLUME x ROLE_SHARE x yards per carry E
multiplicative_chains.targets / carries: frozen Phase1B team projection TEAM_VOLUME x frozen Phase1D share ROLE_SHARE

component_conventions.qb: BLOCKED_STARTER_STATE_DATA for any decomposition; only the aggregate Phase1F oracle workload/efficiency diagnostic of the frozen 2025 validation is reported, labelled POSTGAME_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY
component_conventions.undefined_actual_component: A realized per-target / per-catch / per-carry component can be undefined (zero targets, zero receptions, zero carries). The oracle then keeps the predicted value for that component, which keeps the all-oracle value equal to the actual outcome; such rows are kept and counted.

dominant_cause_rule: A miss is assigned the component whose row-level Shapley contribution is >= 50% of the row error; otherwise MULTIPLE_COMPONENTS; rows without a component split are UNRESOLVED. Rushing efficiency is relabelled EXPLOSIVE_TAIL only when the Phase1K tier-mixture surprise has the same sign and is >= 50% of the efficiency-yards error. AVAILABILITY, GAME_SCRIPT and QB_STATE are never inferred (no supporting receipt field). OPPORTUNITY_UNSPLIT is an added honest label where team volume and role share are not separable.
fixed_cohort_rule: Every oracle comparison inside a head uses IDENTICAL rows. A head cohort is the intersection of rows where all required components exist. Population n, cohort n, exclusion reasons and the key digest are reported; the normal MAE of excluded rows is shown where computable so exclusions cannot hide difficult rows. MAE is never compared across different populations.

no_new_access: no outcome data beyond what prior phases legitimately opened
no 2025 rows a frozen phase never opened
no downloads or raw data files
preregistration: Committed before any Phase1R result exists. This phase is MEASUREMENT ONLY: no regression, learner, hyperparameter search, feature family, Monte Carlo, sportsbook input or new data access. It reads only committed, digest-pinned frozen artifacts and receipts.
question: Where does the remaining error of the surviving V2 chain come from, and what NEW information has the highest potential value?
registry_cleanup: Only top-level status, next_milestone, open_research_tracks, frozen_or_blocked and a new current_state block change. No historical phase record is mutated.
reproducibility: stdlib only; explicit left-to-right float accumulation; sorted-key JSON rounded to 6 decimals; no network, no raw data, no model code.

shapley.additivity: row-level contributions sum exactly to (normal error - all-oracle error); MAE gains from single oracles are NOT additive and the gap is reported
shapley.label: DIAGNOSTIC attribution only; never predictive lift
shapley.method: exact Shapley of the absolute-error reduction over all 2^n component replacement orders, per row, averaged over identical rows

tiering.amendment_note: The first mechanical pass of the draft tier rule (before this commit) ranked families with no identified validation path or low measurement confidence into Tier 1 on share alone; validation_path and confidence were added to the rule before anything was committed. The first-pass output is not retained.
tiering.metric: estimated addressable share = (normal MAE - MAE with the family's components replaced by realized values) / normal MAE on the best-evidenced head; for a target-opportunity component the estimate uses the team-vs-role split measured on the 2024 targets head
rules: TIER_1 requires: estimated addressable share >= 0.25 on a head (row-level, or for the QB head the frozen Phase1F aggregate oracle workload gain), directly_measures, represented_by_failed == NONE, validation_path == HISTORICAL_AND_LIVE_PLAUSIBLE, confidence >= MEDIUM_HIGH
TIER_2 requires: share >= 0.10, directly_measures, represented_by_failed in (NONE, PARTIAL_PROXY_FAILED), validation_path in (HISTORICAL_AND_LIVE_PLAUSIBLE, FORWARD_ONLY)
TIER_3 requires: share >= 0.05 and timing != no
DO_NOT_PURSUE if timing == no or not directly_measures
a family whose signal already failed (FAILED_SAME_SIGNAL) is capped at TIER_4
a family with validation_path == NONE_IDENTIFIED is capped at TIER_3

QB starter state: the QB head cannot be decomposed at row level (blocked); its evidence is the frozen Phase1F aggregate oracle diagnostic (POSTGAME_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY) plus the indirect row-level team-volume and catch/air components, and this is stated wherever it is ranked
tiering.upper_bound_warning: Potential addressable error is an UPPER BOUND, not expected model improvement. Buying a source will not achieve the oracle gain.

validation_path_definitions.FORWARD_ONLY: live capture is possible (e.g. public reports) but no historical vintage exists, so validation needs a forward season
validation_path_definitions.HISTORICAL_AND_LIVE_PLAUSIBLE: an identified route exists to obtain original-vintage history AND live feed (licensed archive with vintages, or public data)
validation_path_definitions.NONE_IDENTIFIED: no identified way to make pregame timing valid
